Every run judged cli:claude-fable-5-1 under judge contract v2 except o3_opus (cli:claude-opus-5, same artifact as o3_fable). codes = first gate code of each failure string. n = production prompt summary-2026-09-n (control); o = summary-2026-09-o (candidate). o2 has 68 complete verdicts (two lost to an exhausted judge quota). verify_audit = the in-generation verifier's record on the o3 artifact: flagged slots and its verdict per slot.
